description:
Two issues in crate-jmap-calendars-client/README.md:

1. README says '18 typed async fn methods'; actual count is 19 (Calendar 3 + CalendarEvent 7 + CalendarEventNotification 5 + ParticipantIdentity 3 + Principal 1 = 19). Off-by-one.

2. First sentence reads: 'RFC 8620 typed client methods for JMAP Calendars (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26)'. RFC 8620 is the JMAP base; the calendar methods belong to the calendars draft. Should drop 'RFC 8620' or rewrite as 'Typed JMAP client methods for JMAP Calendars (draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26)'.

Fix both in one edit.
title: P3: calendars-client README cardinality and RFC 8620 mis-attribution
